mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_bank_interface_config SET is_enabled = #{isEnabled}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE config_id = #{configId}

UPDATE settlement_bank_interface_config SET last_health_check_time = #{lastHealthCheckTime}, health_status = #{healthStatus}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE config_id = #{configId}

UPDATE settlement_bank_interface_config SET is_enabled = 1, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE config_id IN
#{id}

UPDATE settlement_bank_interface_config SET is_enabled = 0, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE config_id IN
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_bank_interface_config WHERE is_enabled = 1 AND health_check_url IS NOT NULL AND ( last_health_check_time IS NULL OR last_health_check_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL health_check_interval MINUTE) ) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY last_health_check_time ASC
SELECT * FROM settlement_bank_interface_config WHERE health_status = 'UNHEALTHY' AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY last_health_check_time ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enabledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as disabledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN health_status = 'HEALTHY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as healthyCount, SUM(CASE WHEN health_status = 'UNHEALTHY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unhealthyCount, SUM(CASE WHEN health_status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unknownCount FROM settlement_bank_interface_config WHERE org_id = #{orgId}

SELECT bank_code, bank_name, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enabledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN health_status = 'HEALTHY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as healthyCount FROM settlement_bank_interface_config WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY bank_code, bank_name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT interface_type, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enabledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN health_status = 'HEALTHY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as healthyCount FROM settlement_bank_interface_config WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY interface_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT protocol_type, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enabledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN health_status = 'HEALTHY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as healthyCount FROM settlement_bank_interface_config WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY protocol_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT * FROM settlement_bank_interface_config WHERE is_enabled = 1 AND interface_type = #{interfaceType} AND (health_status IS NULL OR health_status = 'HEALTHY') AND load_balance_weight > 0 AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY load_balance_weight DESC, priority DESC

SELECT * FROM settlement_bank_interface_config WHERE is_enabled = 1 AND interface_type = #{interfaceType} AND (health_status IS NULL OR health_status = 'HEALTHY') AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY CASE health_status WHEN 'HEALTHY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, priority DESC, load_balance_weight DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM settlement_bank_interface_config WHERE is_enabled = 1 AND interface_type = #{interfaceType} AND config_id != #{primaryConfigId} AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY CASE health_status WHEN 'HEALTHY' THEN 1 WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, priority DESC, load_balance_weight DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_bank_interface_config SET usage_count = COALESCE(usage_count, 0) + 1, last_used_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE config_id = #{configId}
mapper.select: SELECT config_id, bank_code, bank_name, interface_type, usage_count, last_used_time, CASE WHEN last_used_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN last_used_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 'RECENT' WHEN last_used_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 'INACTIVE' ELSE 'UNUSED' END as usage_status FROM settlement_bank_interface_config WHERE org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY usage_count DESC, last_used_time DESC
